biscuit.reason: Real-hardware host-mode, CDC-ECM, DHCP, link-loss, and USB-serial restoration are implemented.

radar.reason: Radar has no external USB port; power, enumeration, and recovery must be qualified with the internal pads and a powered adapter.

checkers.reason: The Tater custody baseline is pinned; boot it, then qualify board-specific role control, VBUS, enumeration, and serial recovery.

crown.reason: Crown's Tater custody baseline is pinned; its connector, role control, VBUS, and recovery still require independent qualification.

athena.reason: The Tater MTU3 dual-role kernel boots on Athena; normal-cable device mode, bounded host/device switching, USB serial/RNDIS restoration, reboot, and Wi-Fi fallback passed. An OTG Ethernet adapter is still required to validate VBUS, enumeration, DHCP, traffic, link loss, and unplug.

rook.reason: The Tater custody baseline is pinned; boot it, then qualify external usb0 without disturbing the separate usb1 Wi-Fi bus.
